entries.title: Meridian staff non-solicit
entries.summary: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd may not solicit or hire any employee or consultant of Meridian Healthcare with whom AtliQ had contact during the potential engagement evaluation.
entries.quote: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months thereafter, the Recipient shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or engagement, or employ or engage, any employee or consultant of Meridian with whom the Recipient had contact in connection with the Purpose, without Meridian's prior written consent.

relatedClauses.quote: Meridian intends to disclose certain information to the Recipient for the purpose of evaluating a potential engagement relating to clinical operations analytics and hospital performance dashboards (the "Purpose"), including a walkthrough of Meridian's data environment.

entries.notes: One-way restriction on AtliQ that extends to both soliciting and direct hiring of Meridian's personnel.

entries.title: DPDP compliance and 24-hour breach notification
entries.summary: AtliQ must comply with the DPDP Act 2023 for any patient or health data and notify Meridian within 24 hours of discovering any unauthorized access or disclosure.
entries.quote: comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 in relation to any personal data, including health data, forming part of the Confidential Information; and (e) notify Meridian within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of any unauthorised access or disclosure.

relatedClauses.quote: This Agreement shall remain in force for three (3) years from its date. The Recipient's obligations shall survive for three (3) years after expiry or termination.

entries.notes: Imposes a strict 24-hour notification window for unauthorized access or disclosures, alongside statutory compliance obligations under Indian data protection law.
